# Termux-Train Full Technical Specification (v1.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Lightweight On-Device Tensor & DAG Autograd Deep Learning Framework for Android
Provides a clean C-based DAG computation graph with SafeTensors zero-copy serialization and LoRA adapter fine-tuning on smartphone CPUs.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-train
- Command: pip install termux-train
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-train
